sharedCore: factor/multiple direction in a product relationship
factorization as product representation of a polynomial
verify a proposed factor using a polynomial quotient and multiplication-back identity
differences: Nani-indexed handout locates factor/multiple definition on p.87 and factorization-as-product representation on p.88, using an integer-to-polynomial analogy; the chapter locator is clearer than recoverable full teaching prose.

Kanghsuan-labeled student notes foreground divisibility and quotient roles; OCR is too noisy for example-level use, so this lesson retains only the conceptual bridge and supplies independent examples.

Hanlin's official search index identifies factor/multiple discrimination at the start of the remediation sequence; the share contents list later methods separately. This supports sequencing, not claims about the unread official page's diagrams or exercises.
synthesis.originalLessonDesign: Rebuilt the lesson around a postage-wall/seat-row product model, candidate factor and quotient, full multiplication-back verification, and counterexamples that distinguish falsification from proof and expose partial coefficient matching. Corrected the (x+3)(x+4) check to x^2+7x+12, not x^2+7x+10. Excluded common-factor, difference-of-squares, sum-product pairing, and cross-multiplication algorithms from this lesson.

changes: Corrected lesson summary, goals, study highlights, and all six teaching phases to the A-8-4 meaning/scope boundary.

Replaced algorithm-selection interaction with factor/multiple direction, quotient construction, multiplication-back, and counterexample diagnosis; added a fifth stage catching the constant-term mismatch in (x+3)(x+4).
Expanded each versionResearch finding with exact public page/topic locators and explicitly excluded unauthenticated or OCR-uncertain examples.
Corrected A-8-4 spec flow/actions that incorrectly claimed factor-tree, draggable algorithm cards and factoring methods outside this unit.
Added focused jsdom runtime regression test and included it in npm test.

Corrected the matching implementation spec scope and regression examples under decision D-314; downgraded all three publisherEvidence slots to pending because current shared sources do not substantiate verified publisher-original full-text research.
